description: Client-side script for 'Invoice Discounting' form in ERPNext, managing invoice selection, account filtering, loan disbursement, and ledger viewing.

classes.name: Invoice Discounting
classes.description: Main form script handling invoice discounting operations, account filtering, loan management, and ledger display.

classes.name: Discounted Invoice
classes.description: Child table script for managing individual discounted invoices, updating totals and filters.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for invoice filtering and account queries.

methods.name: filter_accounts
methods.description: Filters account options based on account type and company.

methods.name: refresh_filters
methods.description: Refreshes account filters excluding already selected invoices.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Handles form refresh, including button display based on document status.

methods.name: loan_start_date
methods.description: Sets loan end date when start date changes.

methods.name: loan_period
methods.description: Sets loan end date based on start date and period.

methods.name: set_end_date
methods.description: Calculates and sets the loan end date.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates form data, calculates total amount.

methods.name: calculate_total_amount
methods.description: Calculates total outstanding amount from invoices.

methods.name: get_invoices
methods.description: Displays dialog to filter and fetch invoices, then adds them to the form.

methods.name: create_disbursement_entry
methods.description: Creates a disbursement entry and redirects to its form.

methods.name: close_loan
methods.description: Closes the loan and redirects to its form.

methods.name: show_general_ledger
methods.description: Displays the accounting ledger report for the current voucher.
